These are the checks the house plugin adds to `pnpm check`. The pre-commit hook runs `pnpm check` before each commit. The list comes from the rules table in [`packages/rules/README.md`](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/README.md#rules-and-checks). The docs link in each row opens that rule's docs on GitHub.

| Rule | Tool | What it refuses | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="comment-discipline"></span>[`comment-discipline`](#comment-discipline) | ESLint | Keep comments local, short, and limited to necessary rationale. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/comment-discipline.md) |
| <span id="no-broken-relative-links"></span>[`no-broken-relative-links`](#no-broken-relative-links) | ESLint | Require relative Markdown links, images, and definitions to name existing tracked or non-ignored untracked files inside the repository. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/no-broken-relative-links.md) |
| <span id="design-no-raw-color"></span>[`design-no-raw-color`](#design-no-raw-color) | ESLint | Disallow raw colours in CSS declaration values outside the design-token files. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/design-no-raw-color.md) |
| <span id="design-no-raw-color-literal"></span>[`design-no-raw-color-literal`](#design-no-raw-color-literal) | ESLint | Disallow raw hex colours and colour functions inside JavaScript and TypeScript strings. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/design-no-raw-color-literal.md) |
| <span id="design-no-unknown-token"></span>[`design-no-unknown-token`](#design-no-unknown-token) | ESLint | Require every `var(--name)` to resolve to a custom property defined in a token file or in the same file. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/design-no-unknown-token.md) |
| <span id="design-scale-value"></span>[`design-scale-value`](#design-scale-value) | ESLint | Require values of chosen properties to come from a fixed scale or from a token variable. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/design-scale-value.md) |
| <span id="design-css-layers"></span>[`design-css-layers`](#design-css-layers) | ESLint | Require every style rule to sit inside an allowed `@layer`, keep a restricted layer to its files, and disallow !important. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/design-css-layers.md) |
| <span id="design-no-raw-element"></span>[`design-no-raw-element`](#design-no-raw-element) | ESLint | Disallow a raw JSX element, such as \<button\>, where the design system's component folder has a component for it. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/design-no-raw-element.md) |
| <span id="shadcn"></span>[`shadcn/*`](#shadcn) | ESLint | Restyling, palette colours, arbitrary values, inline styles, dynamic classes and unknown classes. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/shadcn.md) |
| <span id="esm-only-effect"></span>[`esm-only-effect`](#esm-only-effect) | ESLint | Require ESM loading in production app and Effect workspace-package src; tests, rules and top-level tooling are excluded. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/esm-only-effect.md) |
| <span id="no-hand-rolled-surface"></span>[`no-hand-rolled-surface`](#no-hand-rolled-surface) | ESLint | Forbid building MCP tools, RPCs, and HTTP API endpoints by hand; serve the model through a `Domain.Api`. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/no-hand-rolled-surface.md) |
| <span id="no-hand-run-effect"></span>[`no-hand-run-effect`](#no-hand-run-effect) | ESLint | Forbid running an Effect by hand in a test: no `Effect.run*` and no `ManagedRuntime.make`. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/no-hand-run-effect.md) |
| <span id="no-computed-import"></span>[`no-computed-import`](#no-computed-import) | ESLint | Forbid an `import()` or `require()` whose specifier is computed in production package or app source, so every import stays visible to the Dependency Cruiser and layout graph checks. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/no-computed-import.md) |
| <span id="testing-exports-only-in-tests"></span>[`testing-exports-only-in-tests`](#testing-exports-only-in-tests) | ESLint | Forbid using a package's testing export, a name that ends in Testing, outside test files and outside testing code whose runtime exports are all named Testing. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/testing-exports-only-in-tests.md) |
| <span id="no-cycles"></span>[`no-cycles`](#no-cycles) | Dependency Cruiser | Circular file imports. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="packages-do-not-import-apps"></span>[`packages-do-not-import-apps`](#packages-do-not-import-apps) | Dependency Cruiser | Packages importing apps. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="apps-do-not-import-other-apps"></span>[`apps-do-not-import-other-apps`](#apps-do-not-import-other-apps) | Dependency Cruiser | Cross-app imports. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="packages-imported-by-name"></span>[`packages-imported-by-name`](#packages-imported-by-name) | Dependency Cruiser | Relative cross-package imports. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="packages-public-entry-only"></span>[`packages-public-entry-only`](#packages-public-entry-only) | Dependency Cruiser | Imports past a package's src/index.ts door. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="no-unresolved-deep-package-imports"></span>[`no-unresolved-deep-package-imports`](#no-unresolved-deep-package-imports) | Dependency Cruiser | Unresolved deep package imports. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="production-does-not-import-tests"></span>[`production-does-not-import-tests`](#production-does-not-import-tests) | Dependency Cruiser | Production imports of tests. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="tests-live-in-tests-dir"></span>[`tests-live-in-tests-dir`](#tests-live-in-tests-dir) | Dependency Cruiser | Test files not directly in tests/. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="tests-do-not-import-internals"></span>[`tests-do-not-import-internals`](#tests-do-not-import-internals) | Dependency Cruiser | Tests reaching internal directories. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="no-unresolved-imports"></span>[`no-unresolved-imports`](#no-unresolved-imports) | Dependency Cruiser | Missing imports, except named generated declarations. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="no-ownerless-files"></span>[`no-ownerless-files`](#no-ownerless-files) | Dependency Cruiser | utils/helpers/misc anywhere; caseless mechanism names in packages. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md#package-layout) |
| <span id="package-root-files"></span>[`package-root-files`](#package-root-files) | Dependency Cruiser | Loose package root files other than index.ts. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md#package-layout) |
| <span id="domain-does-not-import-adapters"></span>[`domain-does-not-import-adapters`](#domain-does-not-import-adapters) | Dependency Cruiser | Imports of private adapter production code except by index.ts and adapter code; tests may use adapter test support. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md#package-layout) |
| <span id="subjects-do-not-import-package-root"></span>[`subjects-do-not-import-package-root`](#subjects-do-not-import-package-root) | Dependency Cruiser | Subject imports of their own package index.ts barrel. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md#package-layout) |
| <span id="adapter-imports-only-in-adapters"></span>[`adapter-imports-only-in-adapters`](#adapter-imports-only-in-adapters) | Dependency Cruiser | SQL/driver/platform imports outside package adapters and named plumbing packages. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md#package-layout) |
| <span id="no-subject-folder-cycles"></span>[`no-subject-folder-cycles`](#no-subject-folder-cycles) | Node | Production subject cycles in packages, excluding tests, adapters and root files. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md#package-layout) |
| <span id="no-package-cycles"></span>[`no-package-cycles`](#no-package-cycles) | Node | Production package cycles hidden across files. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md#package-layout) |
| <span id="strict-compiler-flags"></span>[`Strict compiler flags`](#strict-compiler-flags) | TypeScript | strict, unchecked indexes, exact optional properties and other strict flags. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/tsconfig.md) |
| <span id="effect-diagnostics"></span>[`Effect diagnostics`](#effect-diagnostics) | TypeScript | Effect diagnostics at error severity. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/tsconfig.md) |
| <span id="noReExportAll"></span>[`noReExportAll`](#noReExportAll) | Biome | Export-star barrels. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/biome.md) |
| <span id="noExcessiveLinesPerFile"></span>[`noExcessiveLinesPerFile`](#noExcessiveLinesPerFile) | Biome | Files above 300 lines, warning fails the root check. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/biome.md) |
| <span id="noNonNullAssertion"></span>[`noNonNullAssertion`](#noNonNullAssertion) | Biome | Non-null assertions. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/biome.md) |
| <span id="useFilenamingConvention"></span>[`useFilenamingConvention`](#useFilenamingConvention) | Biome | File names not kebab-case or matching an export. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/biome.md) |
| <span id="Formatter"></span>[`Formatter`](#Formatter) | Biome | Two spaces and 100-column formatting. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/biome.md) |
| <span id="exact-pins"></span>[`Exact pins`](#exact-pins) | Node | Ranges, tags, broad workspace specs and Git refs without full SHAs. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/pins.md) |
